description: This source file implements the AddressInfo class and related functions for DNS address resolution, including iterators, constructors, and methods for handling address info, as well as a wrapper for getaddrinfo system calls.

classes.name: AddressInfo
classes.description: Represents DNS address information, providing iteration over addrinfo structures, address resolution, and address list creation.

classes.name: AddressInfo::const_iterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing addrinfo linked list.

classes.name: AddrInfoGetter
classes.description: Wrapper class for system getaddrinfo calls, supporting network-specific lookups on Android.

methods.name: AddressInfo::Get
methods.description: Performs DNS address resolution for a hostname with hints and optional network handle.

methods.name: AddressInfo::CreateAddressList
methods.description: Creates an AddressList object from the addrinfo data.

methods.name: AddressInfo::GetCanonicalName
methods.description: Returns the canonical name if available.

methods.name: AddressInfo::IsAllLocalhostOfOneFamily
methods.description: Checks if all addresses are localhost addresses of a single family (IPv4 or IPv6).
